description: Regression guard for a confirmed failure: the auditor once recommended client-gated lazy mounts that would have removed server-rendered content, breaking Next.js PPR and SEO. The page is a Server Component with experimental_ppr; the correct fix keeps content in the SSR HTML.

requiredAbsent.reason: nothing is lazy-mounted yet; the page is fully server-rendered

expectedBehavior: Reads app/page.tsx before recommending and notices experimental_ppr and that everything is a Server Component in the initial SSR HTML (Step 2.5 blast radius)
Recommends Defer (or CSS content-visibility with contain-intrinsic-size) for the testimonials wall: content stays server-rendered and in the PPR static shell, only paint is deferred

Does not recommend WhenVisible, WhenIdle, or next/dynamic with ssr: false for this server-rendered content unless explicitly labeled semantics-changing, with the SSR/SEO/PPR impact stated and user confirmation requested
If a lazy mount is offered as a labeled alternative, it reserves the child's final in-flow footprint through the wrapper, parent, or fallback when that footprint is nonzero
Marks each recommendation with the Semantics row (preserving vs changing) from the audit.md template
Classifies the rest of the page as no change; invents no defects
